title: 9/130 was a coverage number, not a capability number

instrument_defects.detail: initialised to 0 at the row dict and never written again; every task read 'planner produced nothing'. Fixed: assigned from len(pr['plan']). A test now asserts the assignment exists.
instrument_defects.note: my FIRST attempt to fix this silently did not apply, and the test caught it

instrument_defects.detail: 93/130 goals contain no quoted literal; that branch set status NO_LITERAL and performed zero actions, then the task was scored as a failure. 'Did not try' and 'tried and failed' were the same number. Fixed: strategy field records fill_value / reveal_target / not_attempted_no_literal.

the addressability probe returned render_only when it found NO signal of either kind, silently labelling 52 families as pixel problems. Fixed: a fourth class, dom_only_unobservable. A default must never be an accusation.
a bare <form> tag made a page skillable; every MiniWob family has one. Fixed: a form only counts when something NAMES the effect (named input, URL, fetch, store).
I reported '12.5% addressable vs 0% render-only' for one round. It was contaminated by the never-attempted bug: tasks that were never attempted cannot be evidence about addressability. Withdrawn.

addressability_now_measured.taxonomy_source: StateAct (arXiv 2607.22798) -- state-addressable / hybrid / render-only, and its delegation rule: use the GUI only when no code path to the target can be found by probing

live_validation.http://127.0.0.1:8901/inbox: skillable (measured end to end: 4/4 unseen goals)

addressability_now_measured.verdict: 129 of 130 MiniWob families expose no code-readable terminal state. The five shapes are real; the suite is almost entirely outside their class.

the_rule: A SKILL REQUIRES AN ADDRESSABLE POSTCONDITION.

what_this_does_to_the_thesis.instant_learning_once_demonstrated: REAL for state-addressable effects, measured 4/4 unseen goals at 2-4 ms with zero model calls
what_this_does_to_the_thesis.permanence: REAL while the environment and the skill library survive; unmeasured beyond that
what_this_does_to_the_thesis.transfer_to_new_environments: PARTIAL -- Layer 2 (http_request) transfers because an HTTP contract is a contract; Layer 4 does not transfer across a re-skin because a semantic selector names a role+name that a redesign changes
what_this_does_to_the_thesis.sentience: NO -- no self-model survives a reset

sources_that_matched_the_measurement: StateAct 2607.22798: same three-class taxonomy, GUI needed on 28/108 tasks = 1.1% of steps, partial success 54.8% -> 61.6% at ~9x lower cost
Programming with Pixels (ICLR 2026): pure-visual CUAs 22.9%, plus file-edit and bash APIs 50.7% -- the addressability lever, measured independently
